description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git svn' command, particularly focusing on branching and tagging in a Subversion repository integrated with Git. It includes setup of a Subversion repository, import into Git, and executing various branch and tag commands with assertions on expected success or failure.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, encapsulating commands and assertions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail, used for negative testing scenarios.
